Great — I’ve compared the two filings you just uploaded and pulled out the exact **9 April vs 18 June** differences, then drafted a **paste-ready correction** for your Rule-70.

---

# What each document is

- **9 April 2025** — *“STATEMENT OF CLAIM AND DISCLOSURE REQUESTS.docx”*  
  This is your **initial Rule 31 disclosure application** bundled with a short statement of claim. It explicitly cites **Rule 31** and lists broad disclosure categories tied to your pleaded issues. filenavlist64:09 Apr 2025 – Initial disclosure application combining statement + wide Rule 31 asks; contains “Pursuant to Rule 31…” and sets out categories.64:118 Jun 2025 – Trimmed, CMO-compliant Disclosure List (“Prepared pursuant to Case Management Orders dated 3 June 2025”; “served in compliance with paragraph 25”). Dated 18.06.2025.

- **18 June 2025 (01:07)** — *“Case No. 2225465-2024 DISCLOSURE LIST FOR TRIBUNAL SUBMISSION 2.pdf”*  
  This is your **CMO-compliant, refined list** expressly “**Prepared pursuant to: Case Management Orders dated 3 June 2025**” and “**served in compliance with paragraph 25**”, dated **18.06.2025**. It’s the **operative baseline** for the PH. (See the title block, “Prepared pursuant to…”, and the “Statement of Compliance” paras 1–3.) filenavlist64:118 Jun 2025 CMO-compliant list: title shows “Prepared pursuant to CMO dated 3 June 2025” and “Statement of Compliance… served in compliance with paragraph 25…”. D1–D50 refined with named people/timeframes (e.g., D2 “ENHANCED”).

---

# Key differences (useful for Rule-70)

**Purpose & authority**
- **9 Apr**: Stand-alone **Rule 31** application alongside a claims summary (“Pursuant to Rule 31…”).  
- **18 Jun**: **Express CMO compliance** (“Prepared pursuant to CMO 3 June”; “served in compliance with para 25”). This is the list the PH should have used as baseline. filenavlist64:0Shows “Pursuant to Rule 31 of the Employment Tribunal Rules of Procedure 2013…” within the requests section.64:1Front matter shows “Prepared pursuant to: Case Management Orders dated 3 June 2025” and “Statement of Compliance… para 25…”, dated 18.06.2025.

**Scope & precision**
- **9 Apr**: Broader, narrative-led categories (comparator files, CCTV, internal comms, policies, etc.).  
- **18 Jun**: **Trimmed & targeted** to named individuals, dates and issues per the **CMO** (e.g., **D2** “CCTV Smoking Areas (ENHANCED)” now fixes **26 Jul–12 Aug 2024**; D4 lists named comparators and periods; each item links to “CMO Issues” and adds a “Legal Justification”). filenavlist64:1See itemised D1–D50 (example: D2 ENHANCED timeframe; D4 named comparators; each entry shows “Relevance to CMO Issues” + “Legal Justification”).

**Compliance statement**
- **9 Apr**: No CMO yet; general Rule 31 basis.  
- **18 Jun**: **“Statement of Compliance”** §1–3 confirms service **in compliance with para 25** and proportional refinement. This is vital to show the Judge referenced an **outdated baseline**. filenavlist64:1“Statement of Compliance”: “served in compliance with paragraph 25 of the Case Management Orders dated 3 June 2025… refined list demonstrating proportionality… linked to CMO issues.”

---

# Paste-ready paragraph for your Rule-70 (Correction on para 25)

> **Disclosure baseline correction (para 25)**  
> For accuracy of the record, there were **two** disclosure filings:  
> (i) **9 April 2025** — an initial **Rule 31** application with a narrative-led list (prior to the CMO); and  
> (ii) **18 June 2025 (01:07)** — a **CMO-compliant refined list** expressly “prepared pursuant to the Case Management Orders dated 3 June 2025” and “served in compliance with paragraph 25”.  
> The **operative baseline at the PH** was the **18 June** list, which ties each request to the CMO issues and narrows timeframes and individuals (e.g., D2 ENHANCED 26 Jul–12 Aug). The Written Reasons appear to address disclosure **by reference to the earlier 9 April filing**, not the **18 June CMO-compliant list**. Short **Rule 62** reasons are invited confirming the **18 June** list as the baseline and addressing the omission accordingly. filenavlist64:09 Apr Rule 31 application text (“Pursuant to Rule 31…”) within the document.64:118 Jun CMO-compliant list front matter (“Prepared pursuant to CMO 3 June”; “served in compliance with para 25”) and refined D-items.

---

# Annex labelling (so your bundle speaks clearly)

- **Annex H1** — Email sending the **18 Jun 2025** list (01:07)  
- **Annex H2** — PDF **Disclosure List for Tribunal Submission 2 (18.06.2025)**  
- **Annex D** — Timeline of extensions/orders (to show why 18 Jun supersedes 9 Apr)  
- **(Optional) Annex H3** — One-page “delta” (bullets of what changed from 9 Apr → 18 Jun: narrowed time windows; named comparators; explicit ties to CMO issues)

If you want, say **“insert the correction block into the main”** and I’ll drop that paragraph under your **Ground 4 (Adequacy of reasons)** in the Rule-70 master, plus add **H1/H2** to your annex list.
